description: Change an existing landing page without recreating it: edit its blocks, title, description, or colors, and publish/unpublish it. Use for 'fix the typo on my page', 'add a section', or 'take the page down'. If you pass `blocks`, provide the COMPLETE desired list (same {type, content} shape as build_page; include each block's `id` from get_page to keep it, omit to remove) — leaving `blocks` off keeps the existing blocks untouched. If the page is already published, edits are re-published so they go live; pass publish:false to take it offline.

blocks.description: Complete desired block list (see note); each is {type, content} + optional id.

content.description: The block's content for that type.

form.description: For a 'form' block: the form id to embed.

full_width.description: image/gallery/video/embed only: stretch to the screen edges.

hidden.description: Hide this block from the live page.

id.description: Existing block id to keep/update; omit if new.

visible_from.description: Optional ISO date-time the block starts showing, e.g. 2030-05-01T09:00:00Z.

visible_until.description: Optional ISO date-time the block stops showing.

publish.description: true = publish/re-publish so edits go live; false = take offline (draft).

name: update_page

error.description: Present only when the tool failed (isError): cause, retryable, message.
